declaration.objective: Prospective test of an early closed-hour recovery mechanism against the current Donchian20 plus completed-4h trend strategy. No automatic promotion, no claim of demonstrated profitability.
declaration.long: Use exactly the latest 60 consecutive completed UTC hourly bars. Previous EMA8 < EMA24; previous close minus the close six hours earlier <= minus one previous ATR14. Previous close <= previous EMA8. Current close > current EMA8 and > previous high. Current close minus EMA8 <= one current ATR14. Short is symmetric.
declaration.structure: The extreme over the last six closed hours including signal plus 0.25 ATR buffer must fit the ORIGINAL per-symbol 2 ATR / minimum-stop / maximum-stop initial-stop model. Inherit original symbol minimum stop (MU/SKH 2%, SNDK 0.5%) without widening any stop.
declaration.entry_validity: Freeze max(EMA8, previous high) for longs or min(EMA8, previous low) for shorts. Observed executable quote, mark and final adverse-slippage fill must stay strictly outside that recovery boundary; equality or loss cancels the signal. Retain 0.5 ATR adverse-chase, one ATR extension and one-hour validity. Record actual first-seen time and lag. Early describes price structure, not an instant direction prediction.
declaration.isolation: Twelve NEW hypothetical 1000-USDT accounts: three symbols times baseline/candidate times normal/double costs. This 12000-USDT research capital is independent of original accounts and is never added to main-account profit. Original 48 financial accounts and all histories remain unchanged by this experiment.
declaration.retained_risk: Original 0.25% equity risk, <=1x stock gross notional, leverage ceiling, 2ATR stop, symbol target/trailing/holding limits, three-bar cooldown, official earnings calendar, freshness, spread, depth, funding, basis and drawdown checks; no automatic reversal. Only candidate entry mechanism and its boundary admission differ; it does not wait for completed-4h alignment.
declaration.costs: Double both taker fees and adverse slippage; observed funding settlement logic is identical. Independently size and execute every account against common current public observations. Paths and trades can differ; never force same-trade pairing.
declaration.epoch: Initialize only at verified Aster exchange time after declaration. Warmup candles create indicators only. Admit only signal boundaries strictly AFTER inception, never backfill trades, never fill at a historical candle close. Missing/corrupt financial state or changed source/rules requires explicit repair or a new experiment generation, never silent reset.
declaration.known_history: Recent missed SKH recovery and existing RSI/shock mechanism research were already inspected. This generic fixed rule was not parameter-swept or selected for that individual path; any replay of those observations is diagnostic and cannot count as independent validation.
declaration.review: At least 14 elapsed days AND 10 complete positions in EVERY relevant symbol/arm before first comparative review. Readiness is not a pass. Inspect normal and double-cost returns after estimated open close costs, drawdown, turnover, best-winner dependence, calendar/data coverage and independently divergent paths. Insufficient evidence leaves the main strategy unchanged. No automatic promotion.
